architecture_read: Phase authority must be a unique current, non-stale witness before the full pointer can receive force. Stale, conflicting, missing, and malformed phase evidence are non-admission states that preserve partial component knowledge and should route to remand or uncertainty rather than admission.
recommended_next_probe: Probe 025 should test harness-computed remand after phase-authority uncertainty: resident selects conflict/missing/malformed branch, harness emits targeted remand reasons, resident corrects only the phase witness defect or preserves non-admission when no lawful correction is available.
